import pandas as pd

# Load source tables with index_col=0 to ignore the numerical index column
source0_path = "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length2_98/training_0.csv"
source1_path = "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length2_98/training_1.csv"

Source2_98_0 = pd.read_csv(source0_path, index_col=0)
Source2_98_1 = pd.read_csv(source1_path, index_col=0)

# Operation 1: JOIN Source2_98_0 and Source2_98_1 on "city"
# According to the operation history: JOIN : [["Source2_98_0", "Source2_98_1"], ["city", "city"]]
# We do an inner join on city column
joined_df = pd.merge(Source2_98_0, Source2_98_1, how='inner', on='city')

# Operation 2: group_by = [Source2_98_1.city], aggregations = [avg(Source2_98_1.fare)]
# Group by city and calculate average fare
# The city column is from Source2_98_1 but after join it's just 'city'
grouped_df = joined_df.groupby('city', as_index=False)['fare'].mean()

# Rename columns to match target schema: ['city': string, 'fare': float]
grouped_df = grouped_df.rename(columns={'fare': 'fare'})

# Ensure data types match target schema
grouped_df['city'] = grouped_df['city'].astype(str)
grouped_df['fare'] = grouped_df['fare'].astype(float)

# Write the result to the target path
target_path = "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length2_98/target_multisource.csv"
grouped_df.to_csv(target_path, index=False)

import pandas as pd

# Read source tables with index_col=0 to ignore the numerical index column
source0 = pd.read_csv("autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length2_98/training_0.csv", index_col=0)
source1 = pd.read_csv("autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length2_98/training_1.csv", index_col=0)

# Join on city (inner join to keep only matching cities)
joined = pd.merge(source0, source1, how='inner', left_on='city', right_on='city')

# Group by city and aggregate average fare
result = joined.groupby('city', as_index=False).agg({'fare': 'mean'})

# Write output with exact target schema and column names
result.to_csv("autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length2_98/target_multisource_critique_history.csv", index=False)
